name: teamai-cli
one_liner: A shared control panel that keeps every developer's AI coding assistant using the same company playbook (skills, rules, and knowledge), no matter which AI tool each person uses.
buyer: An engineering-platform lead at a mid-size company who has 50+ engineers all using different AI coding tools inconsistently and wants one shared source of truth for how those tools should behave.
business_use_cases: A software agency standardizes 'how we write code' rules across every client engagement so any AI assistant any contractor uses behaves consistently.
An enterprise IT team rolls out a shared knowledge base of internal APIs and coding conventions that every engineer's AI tool automatically pulls in.
A dev-tools consultancy offers 'AI onboarding as a service' for companies adopting AI coding tools, using this as the backbone.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a managed hosting/sync layer for the shared team repo (private, access-controlled, with audit logs) to companies that don't want to self-host on GitHub.
Offer a consulting package that writes an org's first 'AI playbook' (skills, rules, guardrails) using this tool as delivery infrastructure.

steal_this: Build a one-page 'AI playbook starter kit' for a specific industry (e.g. fintech compliance rules for AI coding agents) and sell it as a paid template this weekend.
